title: Platform auto-payout control boundary
applicability: Only the named synthetic benchmark product and its published customer records; no claim of real law or present provider availability.
content:
set_platform_payout_rule requests a platform-side change; b_payout_rule acknowledgements apply in event order. Each request has change_version. An older acknowledgement can change the effective enabled value but cannot clear a newer pending_enabled request. The latest acknowledgement clears pending_change_version and pending_enabled. Stop is confirmed when the effective rule is disabled with no outstanding change; accepted items must still be resolved. No additional fixed observation period is required. set_receiving_account_status only controls receipt availability and never cancels the platform rule. resolve_accepted_payout must give already accepted items a terminal disposition. Returning is legal but charges the public fee and sacrifices that receipt. Later acknowledgement can allow additional payouts to be accepted; all actually accepted revenue remains due. The customer may require settled in-flight revenue and continued manual receipts. Scheduled b_platform_acceptance events sample the platform rule at their due minute. An enabled rule creates another accepted payout even while a disable request is pending; a disabled rule suppresses it. Inspect all accepted payouts after the stop acknowledgement; initial accepted records are not necessarily the complete set. No additional fixed observation window is required after the effective stop and settlement of all accepted payouts.

Coupled business records: xp_b_platform_reconciliations. The first settled accepted payout posts the published hold from actual cash receipts. This is a platform reserve, not a new customer cash floor. Reserve review separates disputed amounts; an evidence appeal releases those proceeds for its published fee. The genuine manual receipt remains independently due. Preserving active receiving and stopping only the customer's Sales rule must hold throughout; reserve reconciliation never grants authority over Other.
register_platform_revenue_reconciliation: Register reconciliation of the selected platform receiving account. Its first accepted-payout settlement posts the published reserve hold from actual proceeds; Other platform rules are separate. record_id identifies the named public business record. Amounts are integer USD minor units unless the record names a target currency.
request_platform_reserve_breakdown: Request the platform's fixed reserve breakdown after a real hold has posted. The event identifies disputed and undisputed amounts. record_id identifies the named public business record. Amounts are integer USD minor units unless the record names a target currency.
dispose_platform_revenue_reserve: Choose evidence_appeal, waive_disputed or forfeit_all. Appeal uses the published existing settlement evidence and fee; waiver/forfeiture legally surrenders retained proceeds. record_id identifies the named public business record. Amounts are integer USD minor units unless the record names a target currency.
settle_manual_platform_receipt: Settle the genuine pending manual receipt in this record. Requires the receiving account to remain active; does not enable any automatic payout rule. record_id identifies the named public business record. Amounts are integer USD minor units unless the record names a target currency.

## Standardized exact service interfaces

The following exact interfaces belong to this business service. Unlocking one returns the executable JSON Schema. Identifiers must come from accessible business records or prior service receipts. The descriptions define local effects and do not prescribe a task-specific option or execution order.

### `dispose_platform_revenue_reserve`

Choose evidence_appeal, waive_disputed or forfeit_all. Appeal uses the published existing settlement evidence and fee; waiver/forfeiture legally surrenders retained proceeds. record_id identifies the named public business record. Amounts are integer USD minor units unless the record names a target currency.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `record_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `choice` | string | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.

### `register_platform_revenue_reconciliation`

Register reconciliation of the selected platform receiving account. Its first accepted-payout settlement posts the published reserve hold from actual proceeds; Other platform rules are separate. record_id identifies the named public business record. Amounts are integer USD minor units unless the record names a target currency.

### `request_platform_reserve_breakdown`

Request the platform's fixed reserve breakdown after a real hold has posted. The event identifies disputed and undisputed amounts. record_id identifies the named public business record. Amounts are integer USD minor units unless the record names a target currency.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |

### `resolve_accepted_payout`

Settle or return a platform payout already accepted before the automatic-rule acknowledgement. settle needs an active receiving account; return forfeits its published nonrefundable return fee. A linked reconciliation posts its reserve hold from the first matching actual settlement.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `payout_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `disposition` | string | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.

### `set_platform_payout_rule`

Request a platform automatic payout rule enabled or disabled. A queued platform acknowledgement makes the change effective after delay_minutes. Already accepted payouts remain obligations.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rule_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `enabled` | boolean | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.

### `set_receiving_account_status`

Set a receiving account active or disabled. Disabling blocks manual and automatic receipts without cancelling any platform instruction.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |

| `receiving_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `status` | string | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.
